spatialui.settings.title: Hoverglass Settings
spatialui.opacity.current.hint: Saved for this screen class. 0% is opaque; 100% is transparent. Items and text stay readable.
spatialui.settings.reset.hint: Restores every page and container override. Click twice; the rotating snapshots can bring a previous config back.
spatialui.settings.global.hint: Open a container to set its own transparency
spatialui.settings.hint: Scroll / PgUp/PgDn · Del resets page · Esc saves
spatialui.settings.save_failed: Hoverglass could not save settings. Changes remain active for this game session.
spatialui.camera.container.hint: When off, chests and other containers keep the first-person view; the inventory keeps its entrance camera.
spatialui.inventory.close.hint: Off closes the panel instantly instead of sliding it away
spatialui.inventory.reopen.hint: Reopening a container inside this window skips the entrance and camera animation. 0 disables the shortcut.
spatialui.layout.player_height.hint: Fraction of the window height the previewed avatar occupies
spatialui.layout.player_x.hint: 0% is the left edge, 100% the right edge
spatialui.layout.player_y.hint: 0% is the top edge, 100% the bottom edge
spatialui.layout.panel_x.hint: Moves the glass panel; 50% centers it
spatialui.layout.recipe_book.hint: Shifts the panel while the recipe book is open; 0 disables the shift
spatialui.feel.open_speed.hint: Pixels per second before the panel settles
spatialui.feel.slide_brake.hint: Deceleration during the slide-in; higher stops sooner (px/s²)
spatialui.feel.bounce.hint: How far the panel springs back after the slide; 0 is a clean stop
spatialui.feel.close_speed.hint: Pixels per second while the panel slides away
spatialui.feel.spring.hint: Spring strength pulling the panel to rest; higher settles sooner
spatialui.feel.damping.hint: Resistance while settling; lower values wobble for longer
spatialui.support.handled.hint: Off leaves every built-in container on the vanilla screen
spatialui.support.fallback.hint: Off lets a screen the camera cannot reach fall back to vanilla
spatialui.support.optin: Treat this screen as a container
spatialui.support.optin.remove: Stop treating this screen as a container
spatialui.support.optin.rule: Already handled by a screen rule
spatialui.support.optin.hint: Applies the glass panel to the screen the settings were opened from
spatialui.support.key.hint: Cycles F6–F10; F8 is the default
spatialui.support.clear_optins.hint: Removes every screen added here, including wildcard rules
spatialui.material.preset.clear.hint: Barely-there fills with thin rims, best on dark scenes
spatialui.material.preset.frosted.hint: The reference look shipped with the default config
spatialui.material.preset.vivid.hint: Heavier fills and rims for bright or busy backgrounds
spatialui.camera.preset.subtle.hint: Closer, flatter framing with a quick transition
spatialui.camera.preset.cinematic.hint: A wider pull-back with a slower sweep
spatialui.camera.level.hint: Zeroes both angle offsets and leaves distance, side and tilt as they are
spatialui.compat.exclude.hint: Leaving the glass panel off for this screen type keeps every menu and slot vanilla. An exclusion written by a wildcard rule is shown here but must be removed in the config file or with the clear button.
spatialui.transfer.copied: Hoverglass settings copied to the clipboard.
spatialui.transfer.invalid: The clipboard does not contain Hoverglass settings.
spatialui.transfer.no_backup: No previous Hoverglass settings are available yet.
spatialui.transfer.snapshot.hint: Each save keeps the previous file in a small rotating history; this restores the latest one
spatialui.transfer.snapshot.none: Hoverglass has no saved snapshot yet.
spatialui.transfer.snapshot.restored: The newest Hoverglass snapshot was restored.
spatialui.hotbar.match_rim.hint: Copies the glass panel's rim strength onto the hotbar
spatialui.hotbar.match_opacity.hint: Copies the glass panel's fill opacity onto the hotbar
spatialui.ui.liquid_glass.hint: Rounded glass and hover highlights for standard buttons and sliders in pause, options and settings menus. Applies instantly, independently of glass inventory.
